definitions.explanation: A large area covered with trees.

examples.japanese: {森|もり}の{中|なか}を{散歩|さんぽ}した。
examples.english: I took a walk in the forest.

examples.japanese: この{森|もり}には{動物|どうぶつ}がたくさんいる。
examples.english: There are many animals in this forest.

notes: More casual than {森林|しんりん}. Also common as a surname.
